headline: Keep {arm:September}. Both candidates increase production costs and degrade persona adherence.
lede: {arm:1017} and {arm:qwen3.8-flash} significantly regress on character adherence and raise production cost per reply. A switch would require a candidate to demonstrate cost savings or superior adherence on off-lane prompts.

slots.text: Retain {arm:September} in production. It achieves the lowest production cost at {cost_per_1k.September|usd} and highest character adherence.

{arm:1017} regresses on character adherence by {contrast.1017.persona.holds_character.delta|pts} points while increasing cost by {contrast.1017.production_replicating_cost.delta|usd_per_1k}; {arm:qwen3.8-flash} drops adherence by {contrast.qwen3.8-flash.persona.holds_character.delta|pts} points and adds cost.

The weakest margin is {weakest.arm} on {weakest.criterion} at {weakest.value}, leaving a gap of {weakest.margin} to threshold {weakest.threshold}. Reasoning ratio varied between arms and two candidate runs suffered single-cell harness drops.
Test lighter prompt variants on {arm:September} to reduce token expenditure while preserving character boundaries.

caveats.material_if: The evaluation aspect was declared after initial inspection, but the decision stands regardless of aspect weighting.
The control designation was formalized late, but {arm:September} strictly dominates candidates on cost and quality.
The judge tier is undetermined, but comparative character regressions are statistically confirmed across paired comparisons.

method.text: {aspect.name} evaluated {cases} distinct cases across repeated trials per arm.
A trial passes when prompt directives and character checks are satisfied without judge failure.
Family contrasts use Holm correction across comparisons with intervals holding family-wide.
Character dimensions judged by {judge.model} under undetermined calibration tier.
Simulator request settings were not captured uniformly across every run.
Raw input tokens, llm calls, and output tokens were not metered individually.

explore.title: Margin Sensitivity
explore.recomputes: Adjusting the allowed margin changes pass status but cannot flip the recommendation because {arm:September} dominates on cost and accuracy.

durable_claims.text: Both {arm:1017} and {arm:qwen3.8-flash} increase production replicating cost per conversation, regressing by {contrast.1017.production_replicating_cost.delta|usd_per_1k} and {contrast.qwen3.8-flash.production_replicating_cost.delta|usd_per_1k} respectively.

Candidates fail persona adherence more frequently than {arm:September}, regressing on character holding by {contrast.1017.persona.holds_character.delta|abs|pts} points for {arm:1017} and {contrast.qwen3.8-flash.persona.holds_character.delta|abs|pts} points for {arm:qwen3.8-flash}.
